{{Top|leg}}
A '''drone fighter''' was an automated [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]].

==History==
[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] was attacked by a squadron of these fighters launched from a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] ship, in [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]].<ref name="LRFO">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref>

They were utilized by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during [[Operation Hammerblow]], the live fire readiness exercise for the [[New Republic Fifth Fleet]].
